_about: Demon Horde's weapon blessings (MORDHAU's PackAPunch effects) on enchanted weapons in Skyrim: a glow on the weapon itself (MORDHAU's M_PackAPunch: additive, unlit, its noise texture), sparks and smoke along the weapon (MORDHAU's P_EnchantGlow: emitters FlashBall, FlashBall_Local and Smoke) and a trail behind a swing (MORDHAU's P_WeaponTrailGlow / P_WeaponTrailLinger). Drawn by the plugin from MORDHAU's own textures, read from the player's install into the local cache; nothing changes inside MORDHAU. Which look a weapon gets: the first row whose resist matches one of the weapon's Skyrim enchantment effects (its magic effect's resistance value); an enchanted weapon matching none gets the row with an empty resist. The enchantment's damage stays Skyrim's own. Colours are linear rgb, 0..1. The user, 2026-10-15: 'demon horde has some really nice elemental effects on the weapons can we get that in somehow' ... 'yes do all of em'.

rows.source: MORDHAU's fire blessing trail (P_BlessingTrailArrowsFire) is orange; colour chosen by eye to match it, not read from the file
MORDHAU has no frost blessing: its effect in an icy blue (choice)
